answer: Verifiers send each payout-eligible agent ID an unannounced task, and every ID on a relay gets its task in the same two-second window. Each answer takes about 40 seconds of GPU work keyed to that ID and is due in 60, so one card can't cover two IDs. 500 fakes means 500 cards running at once. On our river-gauge bridge pool, an ID that missed two pings lost its payout slot. A bulk ivory-tower datacenter deal doesn't help, because the bill still grows per ID.
